rows.definition: internal/buildwitness is a structural CI-guard package whose test runs `go build ./cmd/fak` under default build tags from a clean checkout, proving the default build is green independent of any WIP file left tagless in the shared tree.
rows.distinction: A compile-time PROOF that the default build succeeds, not the worktreewitness detached-trunk command harness or a diff/claim evidence witness such as WitnessOK.

rows.definition: internal/dispatchtick.CommitWitnessed(verdict, witness string) bool grades one `dos commit-audit` row into a dispatch-tick worker slot's productive keep-bit, true only when verdict is OK AND witness equals the diff-witnessed constant WitnessOK.
rows.distinction: A boolean GRADING function over an already-produced audit verdict, not ClaimWitnessed's dispatch-tick sweep verdict or WitnessSidecarSuffix's audited-once file marker in the same package.

rows.definition: internal/cachemeta.InvalidationExternalRefutation ("external_refutation") is the InvalidationMode enum value recording that a cache entry's Coherence.InvalidationMode was set because its bound external world-state witness was refuted, as opposed to LRU, TTL, write-epoch, or policy eviction.
rows.distinction: One specific enum VALUE naming the refutation cause of one cache entry's eviction, not the generic Refutation type/action elsewhere or its InvalidationLRU / InvalidationTTL / InvalidationWriteEpoch sibling causes.

rows.definition: internal/milestonereport.MissingWitnesses (int, mirrored into internal/operatorbrief) is the per-lane roadmap COUNT of epics/issues lacking a witness, weighted 3x into the lane's DebtScore.
rows.distinction: A plural per-lane roadmap-debt COUNT, not the singular MissingWitness list of unwitnessed friction classes in internal/devexmeter, and not gateway/deepseek_budget's NativeSupport.MissingWitnesses (a []string naming the specific absent load-bearing witnesses behind one DeepSeek native-support claim).

rows.definition: cmd/fak's vcacheContextAPIStatus.NoKeyWitnessCommand field documents the exact CLI command ("fak vcache context-witness") a caller without a live provider API key can run to witness vCache context savings.
rows.distinction: One documented status-struct field naming a single CLI command, not the broader WitnessCommands list of observed-proof commands cataloged elsewhere.

rows.definition: internal/closureaudit.OpenWitnessed ("OPEN_WITNESSED") is the closure-audit BUCKET assigned to an issue that is still open on GitHub but already carries a Resolving-kind witnessed commit - the bucket the close arm drives to CLOSED.
rows.distinction: The per-issue BUCKET LABEL an audit assigns, not WitnessedOpen's numeric loop-economics COUNT of how many such issues exist in a report window.

rows.definition: internal/ctxplan.ProvenanceWitnessed ("WITNESSED") is the strongest of four ordered evidence-provenance labels (FALLBACK < MODELED < OBSERVED < WITNESSED) on an EffectiveContextEnvelope row, meaning the row's default budget came from a local same-task measured run rather than a prior or external telemetry.
rows.distinction: A per-row EVIDENCE-STRENGTH provenance label on a context-budget envelope, not the three-valued WitnessOutcome gate verdict (Confirmed/Refuted/Abstain) used elsewhere in the tree - though gateway and toolsandbox independently declare the identically-named WITNESSED provenance constant for the same evidence-strength meaning.

rows.definition: internal/gateway.ReasonLoopBodyUnwitnessed is the Go constant declared in adjudicate_proposed.go (and reused by subagent_witness.go for the subagent fold boundary) whose string value is the wire reason LOOP_DONE_UNWITNESSED.
rows.distinction: The Go IDENTIFIER for the constant, not the already-catalogued wire-string value LOOP_DONE_UNWITNESSED itself, and not package abi's separate ReasonUnwitnessed deny-reason constant.

rows.definition: internal/memvaluescore scores a KPI row keyed "recall_value_witnessed" (Group "value") as a binary pass/fail on whether the recall-events ledger has any witnessed rows at all - rows `fak memory recall` appends only when a real recall witnesses an event.
rows.distinction: One specific memvaluescore KPI row key testing ledger non-emptiness, not the TallyFromCountersWitnessed realized-deny fold or the generic WitnessOutcome verdict.

rows.definition: cmd/causalbench's step-4 "TARGET" assertion is the causal-targeting property that calling Revoke on one witness must evict ONLY entries admitted under that witness - refuting an unrelated witness must evict zero unrelated entries, proving eviction is causally targeted rather than a blunt flush.
rows.distinction: A BLAST-RADIUS test/property asserted over a refutation's effect, not the refute action itself (vdso.Revoke, cataloged as "refute (revocation trigger)") nor the Refutation type it produces.

rows.definition: internal/modelroute.VerifyWitness (Verification = "witness") is the strongest model-route verification tier, meaning DOS confirmed the work from git evidence (dos verify / dos commit-audit); Trusted() and Witnessed() both gate on it above VerifyJudge.
rows.distinction: A named VERIFICATION-TIER constant on the model-route quality axis, not the three-valued WitnessOutcome gate verdict, and not the identically-named internal/vcacheqa.VerifyWitness function (a thin pass-through to the real QA-gate test).

rows.definition: internal/cacheprice.ShedTokenEquiv's warmWitness parameter is the OBSERVED provider cache_read count witnessing how many shed compaction tokens the provider was already serving warm; the function blends min(shed, warmWitness) at ReadMultiplier and the remainder at full input price.
rows.distinction: A per-call numeric OBSERVED count fed into a pricing formula, not a qualitative per-row provenance label like ProvenanceWitnessed.

rows.definition: internal/contextq.WitnessDosVerify (WitnessKind = "dos_verify") is the playbook WitnessKind enum value meaning a loop-ledger counter increment was earned because the referenced work was independently confirmed via a dos_verify / `fak <leaf>` ship-stamp, not merely claimed.
rows.distinction: A contextq playbook evidence-kind value, not internal/supportmaturity's WitnessKind enum for rung promotion, and not the identically-named internal/conceptbench.WitnessDosVerify constant that instead names the referee tool behind a concept-bench probe's WitnessSource field.

rows.definition: cmd/fak's loopEconWitnessed.WitnessedOpen (int64, JSON "witnessed_open") is the ledger-derived COUNT of issues in the OpenWitnessed closure-audit bucket at report time, rendered in `fak loop economics` as "witnessed-done still open".
rows.distinction: A folded numeric COUNT over a report window, not the per-issue OpenWitnessed bucket label itself.

rows.definition: internal/supportmaturity.WitnessKind (uint8) is the enum of evidence kinds - produced per-Rung by WitnessFor - that PROVES a support-maturity rung promotion is earned rather than merely claimed.
rows.distinction: The evidence-kind TYPE the prover returns, not WitnessFor (the function that maps a Rung to its required WitnessKind), and not the differently-typed (string) internal/contextq.WitnessKind used for playbook loop-ledger counters.

rows.definition: internal/dispatchtick.WitnessSidecarSuffix (".witness") is the on-disk file-name suffix marking a dispatch-tick worker slot as audited-once, since a landed commit's diff (and so its verdict) is immutable and a slot must be graded exactly one time.
rows.distinction: A file-naming CONVENTION/idempotency marker, not CommitWitnessed's boolean grading function in the same package.

rows.definition: internal/conceptbench's Verdict.WitnessSource is a string field naming the exact real DOS tool that answered one concept-bench probe (e.g. dos_verify, dos_arbitrate, dos_check_reason), so a probe's verdict can be traced back to which referee produced it.
rows.distinction: A per-verdict field naming WHICH referee answered, not the generic WitnessResolver interface that corroborates claims across the wider tree.

rows.definition: internal/worktreewitness runs an arbitrary command inside a transient, self-reaping detached git worktree pinned at the resolved origin/main SHA, so the verdict reflects the trunk tip and is never contaminated by a peer's dirty uncommitted WIP in the shared working tree.
rows.distinction: A general detached-worktree command RUNNER for any caller-supplied command, not buildwitness's narrower single-purpose `go build ./cmd/fak` compile proof.
